title: The Eyes Have Hills
author: Abigail Golden
problems: Row 4 "mad robins, robins in front" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 5 "robins start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 6 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 6 "partners swing" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 7 "long lines forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 9 "partners California twirl" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 2 and 3 are too far apart to twirl.
Row 1 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "left diagonal robins chain to shadow" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
Row 8 "pass through across the set" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
